title: Death of Sargon II (Sardanapalus II); second Median revolt
summary: Sargon II of Assyria is killed on campaign and the Medes revolt, gaining independence by 700 B.C.
description: CFAH-5 anchor point AP-34. CFAH reads Sargon II as the second king the chroniclers called Sardanapalus. Added by the CFAH pass.

chronologies.citation: Griffith & White, "Chronological Framework of Ancient History. 5: The Babylonian Dynasties of Berossus," ARJ 16 (2023): 635–670, section "AP-34: Sardanapalus II—Sargon II: Second Median Revolt: 705–700 B.C."
chronologies.note: Sargon II killed by the Umman Manda in 705 B.C.; Median independence by 700 B.C.
